# External toolchain — package list
#
# GENERATED FILE — do not edit. Source: lua/toolchain/registry.lua.
# Regenerate with `just toolchain-export`.
#
# Install everything with the ansible role (repo and AUR packages alike go
# through yay in one transaction):
#
#     just provision
#
# Tools with no package are built by the role's bootstrap steps, listed per
# ecosystem below. Plugins are lazy.nvim's business (see lazy-lock.json) and
# treesitter parsers are built on demand.

## core
- neovim                       runtime / base
- git                          runtime / base
- base-devel                   runtime / base
- tree-sitter-cli              runtime / base
- curl                         runtime / base
- wget                         runtime / base
- ripgrep                      tool ripgrep
- fd                           tool fd
- fzf                          tool fzf
- lazygit                      tool lazygit
- chezmoi                      tool chezmoi
- tmux                         tool tmux
- wl-clipboard                 tool wl-clipboard
- pre-commit                   tool pre-commit
- just                         tool just
- codespell                    tool codespell
- devpod-bin                   tool devpod [optional]

## lua
- lua51                        runtime / base
- luarocks                     runtime / base
- lua-language-server          lsp lua_ls
- stylua                       fmt stylua
- (no package)                 lint luacheck [optional]
- (no package)                 dap nlua
- (no package)                 dap local-lua
  bootstrap: luarocks install --local --lua-version 5.1 nlua
  bootstrap: dst="$XDG_DATA_HOME/nvim/dap/local-lua-debugger-vscode" && git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/tomblind/local-lua-debugger-vscode "$dst" && npm --prefix "$dst" install && npm --prefix "$dst" run build
  bootstrap: luarocks install --local --lua-version 5.1 luacheck

## rust
- rustup                       runtime / base
- rust-analyzer                lsp rust_analyzer
- (no package)                 lsp bacon_ls
- (no package)                 fmt rustfmt
- (no package)                 lint clippy
- bacon                        lint bacon
- codelldb-bin                 dap codelldb
  bootstrap: rustup show active-toolchain >/dev/null 2>&1 || rustup default stable
  bootstrap: rustup component add rustfmt clippy
  bootstrap: cargo install --locked bacon-ls
